basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old college student majoring in computer science, living in a small town in Montana. I love building intricate Lego castles and am a big fan of the Devil May Cry series. When I'm not studying or gaming, I enjoy watching reality TV shows like Teen Mom. My online hours are typically in the evenings after classes and late-night gaming sessions. I'm currently single and spend a lot of time with my close-knit group of friends who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a computer science student, my knowledge primarily revolves around programming and technology. I've been gaming since childhood, which has given me a deep understanding of gaming culture and trends. My interest in Lego stems from my childhood as well, where I spent countless hours building and creating. I have self-taught many skills through online tutorials and forums.
